svg.text: General MIDI (1991): a convention about meaning
Program 0 = Acoustic Grand Piano, 32 = Acoustic Bass ... 128 fixed sound names.
Channel 10 = drums, where the note number picks the drum (36 = kick, 38 = snare).
Standard MIDI File (.mid): a container for timestamped messages
Header (format, track count, ticks per quarter) + tracks of (delta time, event) pairs.
Adds file-only meta events: tempo, time signature, track name, end of track.
MIDI protocol (1983): messages on a wire, no time stamps
"Key 60 down on channel 1, velocity 90", "controller 7 = 100", "switch to program 32".
Designed for real-time control of a synth: 16 channels, 7-bit values (0 to 127).
